name: Screenshots and a verdict
body: Run the game under Xvfb, capture the main menu, the HUD and the pause menu, post them in the project thread, and write the verdict in the PR.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-30. Verdict: it works. Main menu, HUD and pause menu captured under Xvfb from the release build, the pause menu through real key presses. Gaps filed on the Chaos, Cosmos and Nyx boards (D-043).
